subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some risky areas remained the same, even though buildings had changed.”?
options: The photo made climate and planning feel local.
The trial made justice feel alive and unfinished.
Learning one small skill made Noah feel strangely proud.
The inn made history feel ordinary in a good way.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Some risky areas remained the same, even though buildings had changed. The photo made climate and planning feel local.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The trial made justice feel alive and unfinished.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Learning one small skill made Noah feel strangely proud.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The inn made history feel ordinary in a good way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some risky areas remained the same, even though buildings had changed. The photo made climate and planning feel local.」，答案為「The photo made climate and planning feel local.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The photo made climate and planning feel local.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
